Whether you're dancing around the Lohri fire, flying patang on Sankranti, boiling over the Pongal pot or feasting for Magh Bihu, this is the season of thanks and togetherness.

And to our Maharashtrian friends: tilgul ghya, god god bola!

May this harvest bring sweet words, full plates and family close by.

posts.title: Per-function RSVP for UK Asian weddings

instagram.text:
Répondez s'il vous plaît means "please reply". To which bit, though?

At a British Asian wedding, a single yes doesn't tell you much. Auntie might come to the ceremony but skip the mehndi, and your uni friends only want the reception.

With Lumhe, one wedding link holds every function. Each guest sees only the ones they're invited to and replies to each separately. You get a live headcount per function, ready for the caterer, the venue and the seating plan.

Share it on WhatsApp, text or email. No app, no login. Start yours at the link in bio.

#Lumhe #RSVP #BritishAsianWedding #UKAsianWedding #HinduWeddingUK
